description: FinancialFilings gives ChatGPT access to filings, call transcripts, and normalized financials for listed and delisted companies worldwide, 35 million+ filings across 85,000+ tickers, with 20+ years of history. Ask for any company's latest annual report, pull a specific financial line item with its currency and fiscal period, search a filing's full text, or compare metrics across peers. Sign in with your free FinancialFilings account using OAuth, no API key needed. Built on the open Model Context Protocol.
